feasibility_amendment.reason: The first preflight found exactly 48 train episodes compatible with the unchanged 1,278-input Branch-ELM contract after excluding somatic-current protocols.
feasibility_amendment.timing: Applied after preflight failure, before any model training and before any fresh-test outcome evaluation.
feasibility_amendment.change: Role counts reduced from 48/16/16 to 28/10/10 so all 48 compatible episodes remain disjoint.
feasibility_amendment.scientific_constraint_preserved: Somatic-current episodes remain excluded; no new input channel, parameter, or architecture adaptation was introduced.

role: supplementary professor-requested comparison; does not replace or select the primary 06b-c experiment
questions: How does the published 8,002-parameter num_memory_20 checkpoint transfer zero-shot to the enriched HayFlow fresh test?
How does the exact same 8,002-parameter architecture perform when retrained at small scale on train-only enriched HayFlow trajectories?
How sensitive is the result to scheduled presynaptic events versus causally realized release events?

architecture_contract.input_mapping: 639 dendritic excitatory channels followed by 639 dendritic inhibitory channels

input_views.U_scheduled: closest to the original end-to-end Branch-ELM presynaptic input contract
input_views.U_realized: causal membrane-core sensitivity using only successful authentic releases

data_contract.training: train split only, deterministically divided into disjoint fit/calibration/development episodes
data_contract.fresh_evaluation: same sealed 05j-o transition dataset used by the reported HayFlow approximately 0.40 mV result
data_contract.somatic_current_episodes: excluded and counted because the original 1,278-input architecture cannot represent injected somatic current
data_contract.intra_ms_timestamps: binned to the original one-millisecond Branch-ELM input resolution

recurrent_state_contract.reset: zero at each independent teacher episode
recurrent_state_contract.limitation: The diagnostic HayFlow episodes are shorter, so this is a bounded comparison and not a replication of the original training budget.

metrics.primary: soma voltage RMSE after clipping the target above -55 mV, matching the original Branch-ELM convention

comparability_warning: The published 0.6376 mV value and this benchmark are soma-only with target clipping. HayFlow approximately 0.40 mV is an all-642-segment aggregate. Even on the same fresh transitions, those target scopes cannot be ranked as one scalar leaderboard.
prohibited: changing the Branch-ELM parameter count or routing
using fresh-test results for checkpoint or hyperparameter selection
allowing this sidecar to select or veto the primary 06b-c causal result
claiming that 0.40 beats 0.60 without a matched target and metric
